title: hostgroup.propagate
description: Propagate permissions and tag filters to all subgroups of a host group.

groups.description: Host groups to propagate. The host groups must have the groupid property defined. Parameter behavior: required.

permissions.description: Set to "true" to propagate permissions. Parameter behavior: required if tag_filters is not set.

tag_filters.description: Set to "true" to propagate tag filters. Parameter behavior: required if permissions is not set.

hostGroupRef.description: Reference to an existing host group by groupid only.
